---
title: "Billboard Graphic"
execute:
    echo: false
---

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
```


```{r}
billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    week = readr::parse_number(week)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(rank)) |>
  group_by(track, artist) |>
  mutate(peak_rank = min(rank)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(peak_rank <= 10) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = rank, group = interaction(track, artist))) +
  geom_line(aes(color = peak_rank), alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "gold", high = "purple") +
  labs(
    title = "Chart Trajectories of Billboard Top 10 Songs",
    subtitle = "Each line shows how a song's rank changed over the weeks after entering the chart",
    x = "Week on Chart",
    y = "Billboard Rank",
    color = "Best Rank",
    caption = "Billboard dataset from tidyr package"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray30"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```
